issues.description: Method addGuestStudents(int): The problem statement UML (problem_statement.md line 73) declares the method as addGuestStudents(int): void, but the solution implementation (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java line 90) defines public boolean addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents). This return-type mismatch (void vs boolean) creates an inconsistency between the documented API and the provided implementation, which can confuse students about the expected behavior and may cause tests or example code based on the UML to fail.
issues.suggestedFix:
Make the method signature consistent across artifacts. Either:
1) Change the solution to match the UML: implement public void addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents) that updates numberOfGuestStudents (no return value), or
2) Update the problem statement/UML and task description to declare addGuestStudents(int) returns boolean and document the meaning of the boolean return (for example: true on successful addition for non-negative input, false otherwise). After choosing one option, update any tests or example code accordingly.
